# TestScript for 08-subcommands-basic
# Asserts subcommand routing, command aliases, command groups, and hidden commands

# 1. Root without subcommand displays usage / required error
exit-status 2 service-mgr
stderr 'Commands:'
stderr 'create\s+Create a new service'

# 2. create subcommand with args and flags (full root-to-leaf inspector view)
exec service-mgr create web-api -i redis:7 -r 3
stdout '⚙  service-mgr create'
stdout 'service-mgr · root'
stdout 'create · active'
stdout '-v, --verbose\s+bool\s+false\s+○ unset'
stdout 'create\s+command\s+—\s+▸ selected'
stdout 'delete \(rm, del\)\s+command\s+—\s+—'
stdout '<name>\s+string\s+web-api\s+● cli'
stdout '-i, --image\s+string\s+redis:7\s+● cli --image'
stdout '-r, --replicas\s+int\s+3\s+● cli --replicas'

# 3. delete subcommand
exec service-mgr delete web-api -f
stdout '⚙  service-mgr delete'
stdout '<name>\s+string\s+web-api\s+● cli'
stdout '-f, --force\s+bool\s+true\s+● cli --force'

# 4. delete alias: rm
exec service-mgr rm legacy-svc
stdout '⚙  service-mgr delete'
stdout '<name>\s+string\s+legacy-svc\s+● cli'

# 5. delete alias: del
exec service-mgr del cache-svc
stdout '⚙  service-mgr delete'
stdout '<name>\s+string\s+cache-svc\s+● cli'

# 6. list subcommand
exec service-mgr list -n production -A
stdout '⚙  service-mgr list'
stdout '-n, --namespace\s+string\s+production\s+● cli --namespace'
stdout '-A, --all\s+bool\s+true\s+● cli --all'

# 7. Unknown subcommand fails with a did-you-mean suggestion
exit-status 2 service-mgr creat
stderr 'unknown command: creat\. Did you mean "create"\?'

# 8. Help screen shows subcommands (hidden doctor command excluded)
exec service-mgr --help
stdout 'create'
stdout 'delete'
stdout 'list'
! stdout 'doctor'

# 9. Hidden command is still invocable
exec service-mgr doctor -f
stdout '⚙  service-mgr doctor'
stdout '-f, --fix\s+bool\s+true\s+● cli --fix'

# 10. Hidden command is excluded from completion candidates
exec service-mgr __complete export ''
stdout '\"value\":\"create\"'
! stdout '\"value\":\"doctor\"'

# 11. Colour output is forced with CONGA_COLOR and suppressed with NO_COLOR
env CONGA_COLOR=1
exec service-mgr create color-svc
stdout '\x1b\[1;36m  ⚙'
stdout '\x1b\[1;36m● cli'
env CONGA_COLOR=
env NO_COLOR=1
exec service-mgr create plain-svc
stdout '● cli'
! stdout '\x1b\['
